== Summary ==
Identified: [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] (front right, light-blue shirt, taking the selfie; same face as [[:File:Cedrik Vanderhaegen 2023 European Championship.jpg]]; he posted the photograph as Calaglin). Remaining faces unlabeled in a closed 10-player field ([[Stephan de Vos]], [[Quirin Fürgut]], [[Koen Meijssen]], [[Erik Spijksma]], [[Stefan Boersma]], [[Tom Damen]], Cedrik, Martin, [[Floris de Vries]], and Jeroen).
Players at the 2022 Ryloth Regionals in Tilburg. Taken at the [[2022 Ryloth Regionals]] (De Vos en de Craen, Tilburg, Netherlands, 6 March 2022).
